reason: Adds a multi-tab local terminal to the web GUI, using node-pty shells on the host and WebSocket streaming; human review is warranted because commands run with the host user's privileges.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 中提供多标签本地终端，可通过 node-pty 启动主机 Shell 并使用 WebSocket 传输交互内容。
summaries.en: Adds a multi-tab local terminal to the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, running host Shell sessions through node-pty and streaming interaction over WebSocket.

capabilities: spawns interactive pseudo-terminal shells on the host process
executes user-entered commands with host-user privileges
streams terminal input and output over a local WebSocket route
injects a multi-tab terminal panel into the web GUI
